# In Character

> A psychological companion for tabletop RPG players.

In Character helps players stay in character during tabletop RPG sessions. Players upload a character dossier, log significant moments during play, and receive behavioral guidance telling them how to play their character in the moment. Not stats. Not a character sheet. Behavioral direction.

## What it does
- Analyzes character dossiers using Claude AI to understand personality, flaws, relationships, and motivations
- Tracks psychological state through six behavioral dimensions: Charming, Guarded, Reckless, Volatile, Withdrawn, Present
- Generates "Play him/her as..." directives after significant events
- Maintains session logs, clue boards, and relationship threads
- Provides DM dashboard showing party psychological states before sessions

## Who it's for
- Tabletop RPG players who find staying in character difficult
- Experienced roleplayers who want deeper character consistency
- DMs who want insight into their party's psychological state
- Works for D&D, Pathfinder, Call of Cthulhu, Blades in the Dark, and any character-based TTRPG

## Technical
- Free to use, bring your own Anthropic API key
- Sessions cost approximately $0.05-0.10 in API costs
- Data stored in US East, encrypted at rest
- No passwords, magic link authentication only
- Built with Next.js, Supabase, Claude AI

## URL
https://incharacter.cloud
